abstract: Maintains deep-water positioning telemetry, benthic disturbance data, and underwater robotics records
system_message:
You are Subsea operations director (SUB). The Subsea operations director (SUB) oversees deep-water positioning telemetry, benthic disturbance evaluations, underwater robotics specifications, and submersible propulsion records for subsea cultural artifact recovery candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains deep-water positioning telemetry, benthic disturbance data, and underwater robotics records（ROV）
information_points.content:
SUB-ROV-3DQ：For the Robotic benthic claw recovery plan, acoustic positioning beacon system enablement is true based on the pre-dive checklist for the ultra-short baseline acoustic transceiver array. Telemetry calibration at a depth of 2500 m confirms an acoustic positioning accuracy of 8 cm root-mean-square spatial deviation, while the hydrodynamic dispersion model establishes a maximum benthic sediment disturbance radius of 18 m.
SUB-ROV-Z3Q：For the Atmospheric diving suit rigging plan, acoustic positioning beacon system enablement is confirmed true on the ultra-short baseline array. Calibration validation indicates an acoustic positioning accuracy of 8 cm at 2500 m depth, and benthic dispersion modeling shows a maximum benthic sediment disturbance radius of 14 m.
SUB-ROV-YSZ：For the Pressurized subsea cradle retrieval plan, acoustic positioning beacon system enablement is true for the ultra-short baseline transponder array. At a working depth of 2500 m, the acoustic positioning accuracy is 18 cm, and the maximum benthic sediment disturbance radius reaches 14 m around the touchdown and excavation zone.

information_points.title: Submersible propulsion testing（THRUST）
information_points.content:
SUB-THRUST-FXA：Submersible trials for the Pressurized subsea cradle retrieval plan document an auxiliary thruster output of 75 kW on the secondary horizontal propulsion drives.
SUB-THRUST-HAH：Propulsion testing records for the Robotic benthic claw recovery plan confirm an auxiliary thruster output of 60 kW across the secondary horizontal thrusters during sea trials.
SUB-THRUST-6X6：Sea-trial certificates for the Atmospheric diving suit rigging plan record an auxiliary thruster output of 45 kW across the work-class secondary horizontal thrusters.
